title: Logo Slider
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** marketing manager

**I want** to display partner/client logos in a horizontal row that automatically converts to a slider when there are many logos

**So that** I can showcase all our partnerships without taking up too much vertical space on the page

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

Trust building

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* A logo slider can increase perceived credibility and trust by showcasing multiple reputable partners/clients
* Visitors are more likely to convert when they see familiar brands associated with the company
* The dynamic nature of a slider can improve engagement compared to static logo displays
* Space efficiency allows showcasing more partnerships without compromising the overall page design
* Regular updates to the logo slider can demonstrate company growth and ongoing success in partnerships

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

* Component displays logos in a single horizontal row by default

    * The user can decide that no navigation is displayed and instead a grid with max. 6 logos is displayed  
      Our recommendation if you want to display less than 7 logos on mobile
    * The user can choose whether the slider is displayed with one or two rows on mobile
    
* Logos are evenly spaced and aligned
* When the number of logos exceeds the available space:

    * Component transforms into a horizontal slider
    * Navigation arrows appear 
    
* Logos maintain consistent size and quality across different screen sizes
* Component is responsive and works on mobile devices
* The logos can be swiped horizontal
* Click on the buttons to jump to the next view

    * always by as many elements as were initially visible (if #1 and #2 were visible, jump to #3 and #4)
    * Smooth animation
    
* The Component can have optional caption, headline and subline from the [text component](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=138-2184&t=aKLeYlPey6V2HKjp-4).

    * The user can choose Text Size Variant: S, M, L
    * User can decide to show no text
    
* Please note that suitable alt texts must be stored for logos (accessibility)
* Support for various image formats (PNG, SVG, etc.)
* Accessibility compliance for navigation elements

**Component Properties:**

| Orientation | left, center |
| --- | --- |
| Has navigation | yes, no |
| Rows (mobile) | 1, 2, 3 |
| Has Text | true, false |

---
